description: A component receives its collaborators (repository, mailer, clock) from outside instead of creating them.
Dependencies arrive as constructor parameters, usually one typed `deps` object, and are stored as `readonly` fields.
The single place near startup where concrete implementations are created and wired together.
A lightweight working implementation for tests, such as an in-memory repository backed by a `Map`.
Anti-pattern: code pulls dependencies from a global container at runtime, hiding what it needs.
A place where behavior can be swapped without editing code; `createContainer(overrides)` is one.
